summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I found before proposing any changes:** I read through the full watchlist path end to end (read-only, no edits made). Contrary to the ticket's hypothesis, I could not find the specific bug it names:  - Backend (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`): every route requires a valid session cookie, resolves a real `user_id`, and every query (list, detail, create, add item, remove item) filters/writes by that `user_id`. No hardcoded or "default" watchlist ID, no anonymous fallback. - Schema (`modules/watchlist/schema.ts`): `user_id` is `NOT
